title: India Retreat June 2018
text: hello namaste I wanted to let you all know that I'm coming to India in June to Bangalore to lead a five-day retreat and on this retreat we're going to go very very deep the point of coming out a spiritual retreat especially a treat about enlightenment in this case we retreat about evolutionary enlightenment is to give yourself an opportunity to let go of absolutely everything unconditionally and it's only when you're able to let go that much that you're actually able to begin to wake up let go of your own crazy mind let go of everyone else's crazy mind and to begin to discover higher and deeper states of consciousness in which you can experience an ecstatic state of freedom that really changes everything and even more importantly on these retreats not only are we gonna let go of everything and experience the liberating joy of the ground of being but we're also gonna be trying to ask very serious very deep philosophical and metaphysical questions but there's a big part of the spiritual life is not only the experience of meditative freedom but also the the practice of introspection contemplation Who am I why am I here what's the purpose of life why why does he why does something exist versus nothing and most importantly you want to ask yourself are you living a life that makes the most sense are you living is a life you're living in alignment with your own deepest spiritual feelings and intuitions and revelations and if it's not why not and and and if not what do we need to do to change that so most importantly we want our lives to make sense because of our lives don't make sense if we're not living in alignment with with an absolute spiritual principle if we're sensitive Souls we inevitably gonna feel existentially frustrated and disconnected and confused and deeply lost so come and join me we'll figure this out together I've been working on this for 30 years I've got a lot to share with all of you and take it from me life can make deep and profound sense and that changes everything I look forward to seeing you there thank you you
